title: Backward SDE characterization of the finite horizon Principal-Agent problem
summary: We consider the finite horizon continuous-time Principal--Agent problem under deterministic discount factors. Following the Sannikov reduction to a stochastic control problem, we provide a further characterization of the Principal's value function in terms of a backward SDE inducing the corresponding optimal contract. In particular, this allows to bypass the fully nonlinear HJB equation satisfied by the Principal value function in the Markovian setting.
